sn51.15:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
sn51.15:1.3: atha kho uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn51.15:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
sn51.15:1.5: kimatthiyaṃ nu kho bho ānanda samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
sn51.15:1.6: chandappahānatthaṃ kho brāhmaṇa bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
sn51.15:2.1: atthi pana bho ānanda maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa chandassa pahānāyāti.
sn51.15:2.2: atthi kho brāhmaṇa maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa chandassa pahānāyāti.
sn51.15:3.1: katamo pana bho ānanda maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa chandassa pahānāyāti.
sn51.15:3.2: idha brāhmaṇa bhikkhu chandasamādhi padhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.15:3.6: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa chandassa pahānāyāti.
sn51.15:4.1: evaṃ sante bho ānanda santakaṃ hoti no asantakaṃ
sn51.15:4.2: chandeneva chandaṃ pajahissatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
sn51.15:4.3: tenahi brāhmaṇa taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi yathā te khameyya tathā taṃ byākareyyāsi.
sn51.15:4.5: ahosi te pubbe chando ārāmaṃ gamissāmīti.
sn51.15:4.6: tassa te ārāmaṃ gatassa yo tajjo chando so paṭippassaddhoti.
sn51.15:4.8: ahosi te pubbe viriyaṃ ārāmaṃ gamissāmīti.
sn51.15:4.9: tassa te ārāmaṃ gatassa yaṃ tajjaṃ viriyaṃ taṃ paṭippassaddhanti.
sn51.15:4.11: ahosi te pubbe cittaṃ ārāmaṃ gamissāmīti.
sn51.15:4.12: tassa te ārāmaṃ gatassa yaṃ tajjaṃ cittaṃ taṃ paṭippassaddhanti.
sn51.15:4.14: ahosi te pubbe vīmaṃsā ārāmaṃ gamissāmīti.
sn51.15:4.15: tassa te ārāmaṃ gatassa yā tajjā vīmaṃsā sā paṭippassaddhāti.
sn51.15:5.1: evameva kho brāhmaṇa yo so bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññāvimutto tassa yo pubbe chando ahosi arahattappattiyā arahatte patte yo tajjo chando so paṭippassaddho
sn51.15:5.2: yaṃ pubbe viriyaṃ ahosi arahattappattiyā arahatte patte yaṃ tajjaṃ viriyaṃ taṃ paṭippassaddhaṃ
sn51.15:5.3: yaṃ pubbe cittaṃ ahosi arahattappattiyā arahatte patte yaṃ tajjaṃ cittaṃ taṃ paṭippassaddhaṃ
sn51.15:5.4: yā pubbe vīmaṃsā ahosi arahattappattiyā arahatte patte yā tajjā vīmaṃsā sā paṭippassaddhā.
sn51.15:5.6: iti evaṃ sante santakaṃ vā hoti no asantakaṃ vāti.
sn51.15:6.1: addhā bho ānanda evaṃ sante santakaṃ hoti no asantakaṃ
sn51.15:6.2: abhikkantaṃ bho ānanda abhikkantaṃ bho ānanda
sn51.15:6.3: seyyathāpi bho ānanda nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telappajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti. evameva tayā bho ānanda anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
sn51.15:6.4: esāhaṃ bho ānanda taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
sn51.15:6.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ ānando dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
